newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: CRH buys BTR's U.S. unit Tilcon for $329 mln.
newsitem.headline: CRH buys BTR's U.S. unit Tilcon for $329 mln.

text.p: British industrial conglomerate BTR Plc said on Wednesday it was selling its U.S. construction materials arm Tilcon to Ireland's CRH Plc for $329 million.
"The disposal of Tilcon Inc to CRH...is another important step forward in the repositioning of our portfolio of businesses," BTR chief executive Ian Strachan said in a statement.
"The proceeds from the sale will be invested in our key industrial manufacturing and engineering operations as we pursue our strategy for profitable growth," he said.
CRH said Tilcon would have significant synergies with its own U.S. building materials operations in the northeastern U.S.

"Tilcon is an excellent fit with our existing operations, giving the enlarged materials group unrivalled coverage in this key market area," said Liam O'Mahony, chief executive of CRH's North American holding company Oldcastle.

CRH announced the acquisition at the same time as reporting its half-year results. Pre-tax profits were 64.1 million punts ($103.6 million) in the first six months of 1996, 13 percent up on the same period the previous year. ($1=.6184 Punt)
